ov: أفق الحدث (الإنجليزية: Event Horizon) هو فيلم رعب خيال علمي أمريكي إنتاج 1997 من إخراج بول أندرسون وبطولة لورنس فيشبورن،سام نيل،كاثلين كوينلان وجولي ريتشاردسون.تم عرض الفيلم في الولايات المتحدة يوم 15 أغسطس 1997 وحقق إيرادات وصلت ل42 مليون دولار مقابل ميزانية بلغت 60 مليون دولار.
plotEn:
In 2047, a distress signal is received from the Event Horizon, a spaceship that disappeared during its maiden voyage to Proxima Centauri seven years earlier. The ship has mysteriously reappeared in Neptune's orbit, prompting US Aerospace Command to dispatch the Lewis and Clark rescue vessel to investigate. Its crew members—Captain Miller, navigator Lieutenant Starck, pilot Smith, medical technician Peters, engineer Justin, doctor D.J., and rescue technician Cooper—are joined by the designer of the Event Horizon, Dr. William Weir. Weir briefs the others on the ship's experimental gravity drive with a simple visual of how it folds spacetime to instantly transport the ship across vast distances. Weir then plays back the distress signal, which consists of screams, howls, and a voice speaking Latin. D.J. recognises the phrase "līberāte mē", which he translates to "save me".
Upon boarding the Event Horizon, the crew finds signs of a massacre. While they search for survivors, the ship's gravity drive activates and pulls Justin into a portal, then emits a shock wave that breaches the hull of the Lewis and Clark. The crew is forced to relocate to the Event Horizon while Cooper rescues Justin from the portal, finding him reduced to a catatonic state. Smith and Cooper are sent on a spacewalk to repair the hull of the Lewis and Clark.
